name: dock-aso
description: Read and edit App Store and Google Play listings, analyze keywords, review sales and finance data, and inspect app reviews — all powered by the local Dock app on your Mac.
long_description: Dock — ASO Tracker is a native macOS app that centralizes App Store Connect and Google Play Console workflows: editing localized metadata, monitoring keywords and rankings, analyzing screenshots, browsing reviews, and tracking sales and finance. This MCP extension exposes Dock's capabilities to Claude so you can ask natural-language questions and apply ASO changes directly from a chat. The extension is a thin stdio bridge: all data, credentials, and edits stay on your Mac inside the Dock app, which must be running with the MCP server enabled (Settings → MCP).

dock_port.title: Dock MCP server port
dock_port.description: Port used by the Dock app's local MCP HTTP server (default 8765).

tools.name: get_apps_and_languages
tools.description: List all Apple App Store apps configured in Dock with their available languages and platforms.

tools.name: get_app_keywords_analysis
tools.description: Get a detailed keyword analysis for a specific app, language, and platform (popularity, difficulty, ranking, opportunity index).

tools.name: get_app_aso_content
tools.description: Get the current Apple App Store ASO content (title, subtitle, keywords, description, promotional text, what's new) for a specific app, language, and platform.

tools.name: update_app_aso_content
tools.description: Update the locally stored Apple App Store ASO content (draft) in Dock. Changes are saved as drafts; the user publishes them to App Store Connect from the app.

tools.name: get_app_screenshots
tools.description: Get the App Store screenshots for a specific app, language, and platform, iPhone Duo included. Returns the actual images so they can be visually analyzed.

tools.name: get_app_previews
tools.description: Get the App Store app previews (videos) for a specific app, language, and platform: status, size, video link and the poster frame as an image.

tools.name: get_asset_library
tools.description: Read an app's Asset Library on App Store Connect: screenshots, app previews and creative assets, with their state and where each one is used. Read only.

tools.name: get_product_page_creatives
tools.description: Get the product page header and search results creative assets for one language of an app. Read only.

tools.name: get_app_evolution
tools.description: Get the evolution timeline of an Apple App Store app: how title/subtitle/keywords and keyword rankings changed across published versions over time, grouped into periods.

tools.name: get_app_keyword_history
tools.description: Get the historical ranking position (time series) of the keywords tracked for an Apple App Store app, per keyword or for all monitored keywords.

tools.name: search_keyword
tools.description: Look up fresh ASO metrics (popularity, difficulty, opportunity index, competitive insights) for any keyword from the Dock server, by keyword and country — no tracked app required.

tools.name: search_apps
tools.description: Search the public App Store / Google Play catalog for apps by text query (competitor research). Returns store id, title, developer, rating, category and more for any app — not just your own.

tools.name: get_app_intelligence
tools.description: Get a detailed intelligence report for any app on the store by its store id (competitor research): metadata, reviews, and — with a subscription — download/revenue estimates and AI review sentiment.

tools.name: get_google_apps_and_languages
tools.description: List all Google Play apps configured in Dock with their available languages.

tools.name: get_google_app_aso_content
tools.description: Get the current Google Play listing content and ASO analysis for a specific app and language.

tools.name: update_google_app_aso_content
tools.description: Update the locally stored Google Play listing content (draft) in Dock. Changes are saved as drafts; the user publishes them to Google Play from the app.

tools.name: get_sales_summary
tools.description: Get sales summary across all apps for a specific period (month or year).

tools.name: get_finance_summary
tools.description: Get the financial report summary for a specific month (proceeds, partner share, commissions, breakdowns).

tools.name: get_finance_year
tools.description: Get a financial summary for a full year (fiscal or calendar).

tools.name: get_app_reviews
tools.description: Get user reviews for a specific Apple App Store app with summary statistics.

tools.name: get_google_app_reviews
tools.description: Get user reviews for a specific Google Play app with summary statistics.

tools.name: get_twin_apps
tools.description: List all cross-platform twin app links between Apple and Google apps.

tools.name: get_twin_comparison
tools.description: Side-by-side cross-platform comparison of a twin app's Apple and Google listings for a given language.

tools.name: get_web_presence_apps
tools.description: List the apps Dock tracks a website for: domain, last site scan and score, keywords followed on Google, open link building targets, and the state of the DataForSEO account that pays for search data.

tools.name: get_site_audit
tools.description: Get the latest technical audit of an app's website: score per area, every failing check with its fix, tips and facts.

tools.name: get_keyword_research
tools.description: Get the phrases an app is considering for its site, with search volume, advertiser competition, seasonality and twelve months of history.

tools.name: get_google_results
tools.description: Get where an app stands on Google for the keywords it follows, through each channel, plus a tally of who else holds those pages.

tools.name: get_invoicing_period
tools.description: Get who to invoice for one month of App Store proceeds and for how much: Apple's seven paying companies, their billing details, and what each one's share is made of.

tools.name: get_invoicing_outstanding
tools.description: Find the months whose money has arrived and whose invoices have not gone out yet.

tools.name: get_link_building_targets
tools.description: Get the pages worth asking for a link: articles that name the app without linking it, and list articles that leave it out.

tools.name: get_ai_answers
tools.description: Get where an app's site is quoted in answers AI assistants have already given, and which of its pages earn those citations.

tools.name: add_research_keywords
tools.description: Add phrases to an app's keyword research list. Free; reports what pricing them would cost.

tools.name: follow_keywords
tools.description: Start tracking keywords on Google for an app. Free to follow; reports what reading them costs.

tools.name: update_link_building_target
tools.description: Record what happened with a link building target: its state, the address to write to, and what was promised.
